window.description: the lookback window the run covered, both ends inclusive

quiet.description: true when nothing notable changed: items is then empty and digest says so in one line

competitor.description: the company as the owner named it, or "Market" for a topic item

date.description: when it happened or was published, inside the window; for a pricing change seen by comparing pages, the date it was first seen changed

claim.description: what changed, in one line; a pricing change names the old and the new price

so_what.description: why it matters to the owner, in one line

source_url.description: the page that shows the change

baseline_url.description: for a change found by comparing two versions of a page: the older version (an archive snapshot)

confidence.description: high: the company's own page or a filing says it; medium: one credible outlet; low: inferred or one weak source

digest.description: the digest as posted: Slack mrkdwn, grouped by company

to.description: the channel id or email address posted to

status.description: returned_only: no channel was set or no server for it is saved

dropped_repeats.description: changes found this run that the previous digest already reported, left out of items

unreachable.description: each page the plan needed and could not read this run, with why, so a silent week is told apart from a blind one. Never a 404 recovered from (the page found elsewhere), nor a company that publishes no pricing.

reason.description: blocked: a challenge or access-denied page; not_found: gone, nothing in its place; error: a timeout or server error; skipped: left out for the budget

detail.description: what the page answered, in a few words: "bot-protection challenge (403)", "timed out"
